name: Breadcrumb
summary: Where the page sits in the site: a named list of links, the last one the current page.
rungReason: <nav> with a name, an <ol> and links: the landmark, the list count and aria-current carry it all.

a11y.role: navigation landmark named Breadcrumb; a list of links
a11y.name: aria-label

props.items: [{ label, href }], home first; the last is current

rules: The separator is generated content with empty alt text, so it isn't read
The current page stays a link (to itself), marked with aria-current="page"
contrast: Muted links use --lue-color-fg-muted, raised in the -more themes
forcedColors: Links take LinkText; the separator follows the text colour
